body:
Dim a card on the board while any task in its `dependsOn` is **unfinished**. A dependency is unfinished when it is not in a final column of its workflow right now. Complete and cancelled both count as finished. `closedTime` is not the test, because it is never cleared, so a reopened dependency would still look finished.

- Dimming is visual only. The card can still be opened, dragged and assigned.
- The card's tooltip (or a short line on the card) says "Waiting on" and the titles of the unfinished dependencies.
- A dependency can be in another project (the server checks `dependsOn` across the root, D-87). On a workspace or project board, the board still has to learn those tasks' columns and titles. Find out what the board's data already covers before adding a request.
- Tasks saved before D-87 have no `dependsOn`; read it as `[]`.
- The card updates live when a dependency moves column, or when its own `dependsOn` changes from Strategy.
- Update the board README and add tests: no dependencies, an unfinished one, a finished one, a cancelled one, a reopened one, and one in another project.
title: Board: dim cards with unfinished dependencies
